accueil.bienvenue.texte: {nom} finds the games installed on this PC, whether they come from Steam, Epic Games, GOG or the EA app, and puts them in a single library. You launch them from here and follow your play time and achievements in one place.
accueil.bienvenue.langue_aide: You can change it at any time in the settings.
accueil.bienvenue.analyse: Meanwhile, the scan of your PC has already started.
accueil.analyse.texte: {nom} looks at what Steam, Epic Games, GOG and the EA app have installed. Nothing on your PC is changed.
accueil.analyse.arriere_plan: You can move on: the scan carries on in the background.
accueil.analyse.sans_steam: Steam isn't installed on this PC: we still look for Epic Games, GOG and EA games.
accueil.analyse.aucun.texte: That's fine: from your library, you can add a game by hand or point to other folders to search.
accueil.cle.titre: Your Steam key, if you like
accueil.cle.texte: It's optional. {nom} already works without it; with it, it knows a bit more about your Steam account.
accueil.cle.sans_texte: The games installed on this PC, plus public information: store pages, achievement lists, news.
accueil.cle.avec_texte: On top of that: your games that aren't installed, your achievement progress and your friends.
accueil.cle.locale: Your key stays on this PC. It's only used to query Steam, and you can remove it at any time in the settings.
accueil.cle.hors_ligne: You're not connected to the internet: your key will be checked as soon as the connection is back.
accueil.cle.acceptee_texte: Your games that aren't installed, your progress and your friends are on their way to the library.
accueil.cle.refusee: Fix the key, or carry on without it: you can add it later in the settings.
accueil.fin.texte: Here's what {nom} has set up. You can change all of it later in the settings.
accueil.fin.jeux_en_cours.un: {n} game found so far, the scan carries on
accueil.fin.jeux_en_cours.autre: {n} games found so far, the scan carries on
accueil.fin.aucun_jeu: No games found: you can add some by hand
accueil.fin.cle_valide_pour: Steam key added for the account {pseudo}
accueil.fin.cle_non_verifiee: Steam key saved, checked once you're back online
accueil.fin.sans_cle: No Steam key: installed games and public information
ajout.sous_titre: A game that doesn't come from any store: a standalone game, an emulator, a shortcut.
ajout.depot_texte: Or paste its path in the field below.
ajout.depot_actif: Let go of the file to check it
ajout.chemin_aide: An .exe, .lnk or .url file. In File Explorer: Shift + right-click the file, then "Copy as path".
ajout.types.exe: The game's program, in its install folder.
ajout.types.lnk: A shortcut, such as the one on your desktop.
ajout.types.url: An internet shortcut, often created by another launcher.
ajout.titre_aide: Suggested from the file name. You can change it.
parametres.langue.aide: The whole app switches language right away.
parametres.demarrer_avec_windows.aide: The app opens as soon as you sign in to Windows.
parametres.zone_de_notification.aide: Closing the window keeps the app next to the clock instead of quitting it.
parametres.cle.apport: Your key adds your uninstalled games, your achievement progress and your friends.
parametres.cle.garantie: It stays on this PC and is only used to query Steam. Once saved, it is never shown again.
parametres.cle.etat.absente.texte: Only the games installed on this PC appear, without your progress or your friends.
parametres.cle.etat.valide.texte: Steam accepts your key: your games, achievements and friends are up to date.
parametres.cle.etat.valide.hors_ligne: No connection right now: you see the last saved data.
parametres.cle.etat.refusee.texte: It may have been revoked. Save a new key to get your uninstalled games, achievements and friends back.
parametres.cle.etat.non_verifiee.texte: It was saved while offline. Steam will check it as soon as the connection is back.
parametres.cle.hors_ligne: No connection: a key saved now will be checked when the connection is back.
parametres.cle.supprimer.texte: The key is erased from this PC. Without it, this information disappears from the app:
parametres.cle.supprimer.amis: your friends and what they are playing
parametres.cle.supprimer.reste: Your installed games and favourites stay. You can add a key later.
parametres.profil_prive.texte: Your key is valid, but Steam does not share your uninstalled games, your progress or your friends. To get them back:
parametres.profil_prive.etape1: In Steam, open your profile, then "Edit Profile".
parametres.profil_prive.etape2: In "Privacy Settings", set "Game details" and "Friends List" to Public.
parametres.profil_prive.etape3: Come back here: the update can take a few minutes.
parametres.comptes.texte: Several Steam accounts have signed in on this PC. Choose the one whose games, achievements and friends you see.
parametres.comptes.seul: You follow the account {pseudo}, the only one signed in to Steam on this PC.
parametres.comptes.aucun: No account has signed in to Steam on this PC yet. Open Steam and sign in once.
parametres.steam_absent.titre: Steam is not installed on this PC
parametres.steam_absent.texte: Install Steam and sign in once: your Steam games will appear at the next scan.
parametres.dossiers.texte: On top of Steam, Epic, GOG and the EA app, the scan looks for games in these folders.
parametres.dossiers.aide: Paste the full path, for example D:\Games.
parametres.dossiers.erreur.forme: This is not a Windows folder path. It starts with a drive letter, like D:\Games.
parametres.dossiers.erreur.deja_present: This folder is already in the list.
parametres.dossiers.ajoute: {chemin} added. Scan again to look for games in it.
parametres.ajout_manuel: A game the scan cannot find? Add it yourself.
parametres.analyse.jamais: This PC has not been scanned yet.
parametres.affichage.texte: These settings are also at the top of the library.
parametres.masques.montrer.aide: They show up again in the library.
parametres.masques.aucun: No hidden game. To hide a game, open its page, then the other actions menu.
parametres.sources.texte: Each source goes online. Turn off the ones you do not need: everything else keeps working.
parametres.source.fiches_magasin.perte: When off, a game page has no description, screenshots or details.
parametres.source.visuels_magasin.perte: When off, new covers and large images are no longer downloaded: the game title replaces them.
parametres.source.succes_publics.perte: When off, the achievement list and rarity are no longer shown.
parametres.source.actualites.perte: When off, no more announcements or patch notes for your games.
parametres.source.joueurs_en_ligne.perte: When off, a game page no longer shows how many people are playing right now.
parametres.source.en_pause: Paused after several failures. It will be retried later.
parametres.secrets.aide: Shows the text of secret achievements you have not unlocked yet.
parametres.plantage.actif: When the app crashes, a technical report is sent to help fix the problem.
parametres.plantage.inactif: Off: nothing is sent, not even when the app crashes.
parametres.effacer.aide: Resets the app, as on first launch. Your games are not touched.
parametres.effacer.mode_jeu: Finish your game before erasing everything.
parametres.effacer.confirmer.texte: This data is removed from this PC, with no way back:
parametres.effacer.cache: saved data: store pages, achievements, news and images
parametres.effacer.intacts: Your games themselves are not touched: they stay installed and playable. The app then starts over as on first launch.
parametres.niveau.texte: What the app can know depends on the connection and your Steam key.
parametres.niveau.local.texte: Without internet: the games on this PC and the play time measured here.
parametres.niveau.public.texte: Online without a key: Steam store pages, achievements and news, without your progress or friends.
parametres.niveau.personnel.texte: Online with your key: on top of that, your uninstalled games, your progress and your friends.
parametres.valve: This app is not affiliated with Valve. Steam is a trademark of Valve Corporation.
parametres.cle.etat.valide.profil_prive: Steam accepts your key, but your profile is private: see the steps below.
